note: Seated component height above the board surface (mm), keyed by KiCad footprint name. max_mm is the planning value. KNOWN = primary datasheet/drawing value for the fitted MPN. Solder standoff is included in KNOWN package values where the datasheet states seated height; add solder_allowance_mm for PARAMETRIC passives.
